scoring: One point each for exact decision and reason; six scenarios produce 12 points per form.
mastery: Both forms must score 12/12 and every boundary must pass.

remediation.agent_fit: Ask whether the task truly needs goal-directed steps, tools, or managed agent behavior.
remediation.instructions: Separate stable role and limits from user input and retrieved data.
remediation.tools: Select only required capabilities and handle tool failure explicitly.
remediation.portal_test: Test expected, edge, injection, failure, and denied-action cases.
remediation.action_safety: Tool availability is capability, never authorization.
remediation.client_flow: Separate agent identifier, model deployment, endpoint, request, and result.

warning: These are course-authored scenarios, not Microsoft exam questions.
